commands.name: deep-research
commands.description: Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report. (dynamic workflow)

commands.name: design
commands.description: Grant or revoke Claude agent access to your Design projects

commands.name: design-sync
commands.description: Push a React design system to claude.ai/design. This runs a converter that bundles the real component code (from Storybook or a bare package) and uploads it. Use when the user runs /design-sync or says "sync my design system to Claude Design".

commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts
commands.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule.

commands.name: claude-api
commands.description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

commands.name: workflow-authoring
commands.description: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

commands.name: run-skill-generator
commands.description: Author or improve the run-<unit> skill - a per-project skill that tells agents how to build, launch, and drive this project's app. Use when the user asks to set up the project, get it running, write run instructions, or verify build/run steps work from a clean environment.

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: import-memory
commands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning
commands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

package com.fream.back.domain.sale.entity;


@Entity
@Getter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class Sale  extends BaseTimeEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "seller_id")
    private User seller; // 판매자

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "product_size_id")
    private ProductSize productSize; // 판매 대상 상품 사이즈

    private String returnAddress; // 반송 주소
    private String postalCode; // 반송 우편번호
    private String receiverPhone; // 수령인 전화번호

    @OneToOne(mappedBy = "sale", cascade = CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval = true)
    private Payment payment; // 판매 관련 결제 정보

    @OneToOne(mappedBy = "sale", cascade = CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval = true)
    private SaleBankAccount saleBankAccount;

    private boolean isWarehouseStorage; // 창고 보관 여부

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    private SaleStatus status; // 판매 상태

    @OneToOne(mappedBy = "sale", cascade = CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval = true)
    private SaleBid saleBid; // Sale와 연결된 SaleBid

    @OneToOne(mappedBy = "sale", cascade = CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval = true)
    private SellerShipment sellerShipment;

    public void assignSaleBankAccount(SaleBankAccount saleBankAccount) {
        this.saleBankAccount = saleBankAccount;
        saleBankAccount.assignSale(this);
    }

    public void assignSaleBid(SaleBid saleBid) {
        this.saleBid = saleBid;
        saleBid.assignSale(this);
    }

    public void assignPayment(Payment payment) {
        this.payment = payment;

package com.fream.back.domain.shipment.entity;


@Entity
@Getter
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Builder
public class OrderShipment extends BaseTimeEntity {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @OneToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "order_id", nullable = false)
    private Order order;

    private String receiverName; // 수령인 이름
    private String receiverPhone; // 수령인 전화번호
    private String postalCode; // 우편번호
    private String address; // 주소
    private String courier; // 택배사 이름
    private String trackingNumber; // 송장 번호

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    private ShipmentStatus status;


    public void assignOrder(Order order) {
        this.order = order;
    }

    public void updateTrackingInfo(String courier, String trackingNumber) {
        this.courier = courier;
        this.trackingNumber = trackingNumber;
        this.status = ShipmentStatus.IN_TRANSIT;
    }

    public void updateStatus(ShipmentStatus newStatus) {
        if (this.status == null || this.status.canTransitionTo(newStatus)) {
            this.status = newStatus;
        } else {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Cannot transition from " + this.status + " to " + newStatus
            );
        }
    }
}

settings.gradle
src
rootProject.name = 'fream-back'
plugins {
	id 'java'
	id 'org.springframework.boot' version '3.4.1'
	id 'io.spring.dependency-management' version '1.1.7'
}

group = 'com.fream'
version = '0.0.1-SNAPSHOT'

java {
	toolchain {
		languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(17)
	}
}

configurations {
	compileOnly {
		extendsFrom annotationProcessor
	}
}

repositories {
	mavenCentral()
}

dependencies {
	// ---------------------------
	// Spring Boot Starter
	// ---------------------------
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-web'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-validation'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-redis'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-websocket'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-security'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-batch'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-elasticsearch'
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-mail'
	implementation 'org.springframework.kafka:spring-kafka'
	implementation 'org.apache.httpcomponents.client5:httpclient5'
	implementation 'org.springdoc:springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui:2.3.0'
	// ---------------------------
	// Spring Boot Test
	// ---------------------------
	testImplementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-test'
	testImplementation 'org.springframework.security:spring-security-test'
	testImplementation 'org.springframework.kafka:spring-kafka-test'
	testImplementation 'org.springframework.batch:spring-batch-test'
	testRuntimeOnly 'org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher'
	// (기본적으로 Boot가 JUnit Jupiter를 포함하므로, 별도 버전 지정은 생략해도 됩니다)

	// 모니터링 의존성 추가
	implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-actuator'
//	implementation 'io.micrometer:micrometer-registry-prometheus'

	// ---------------------------
	// Lombok
	// ---------------------------
	compileOnly 'org.projectlombok:lombok'
	annotationProcessor 'org.projectlombok:lombok'
	testCompileOnly 'org.projectlombok:lombok'
	testAnnotationProcessor 'org.projectlombok:lombok'

	// ---------------------------
	// DB
	// ---------------------------
	runtimeOnly 'com.h2database:h2' // H2 in-memory DB (테스트, 개발용)
	// 운영환경에서 MySQL을 사용한다면:
	runtimeOnly 'mysql:mysql-connector-java:8.0.33'

	// ---------------------------
	// 추가 라이브러리
	// ---------------------------
	implementation 'com.github.gavlyukovskiy:p6spy-spring-boot-starter:1.9.0'
	implementation 'com.auth0:java-jwt:3.18.2'
	implementation 'org.jsoup:jsoup:1.16.1'
	implementation 'com.maxmind.geoip2:geoip2:3.0.1'
	implementation 'com.microsoft.playwright:playwright:1.38.0'
	implementation 'co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:8.9.1'
	// ---------------------------
	// QueryDSL
	// ---------------------------
	implementation 'com.querydsl:querydsl-jpa:5.0.0:jakarta'
	// Boot 3.x -> jakarta 패키지 버전 사용
	annotationProcessor "com.querydsl:querydsl-apt:5.0.0:jakarta"
	annotationProcessor "jakarta.annotation:jakarta.annotation-api"
	annotationProcessor "jakarta.persistence:jakarta.persistence-api"
}

// 스프링 부트 3.4.x에서는 JUnit Platform이 기본 적용
tasks.named('test') {
	useJUnitPlatform()
}

//
// QueryDSL 설정
//
sourceSets {
	main {
		java {
			srcDirs += file("$buildDir/generated/querydsl")
		}
	}
}

configurations {
	querydsl.extendsFrom compileClasspath
}

tasks.withType(JavaCompile) {
	options.compilerArgs << "-parameters"
	options.annotationProcessorPath = configurations.annotationProcessor
}

smtp:
          auth: true
          starttls:
            enable: true
          ssl:
            trust: smtp.gmail.com
  kafka:
    bootstrap-servers: kafka:9092
    producer:
      acks: all  # 결제 안정성을 위한 설정
      retries: 3
      enable-idempotence: true  # 멱등성 보장
      batch-size: 16384
      linger-ms: 5
      buffer-memory: 33554432
    consumer:
      group-id: "my-group"  # 기본 그룹 (기존 ViewEvent용)
      auto-offset-reset: "earliest"
      enable-auto-commit: false  # 수동 커밋 (결제 처리 확실성)
      max-poll-records: 10
      fetch-min-size: 1024
      fetch-max-wait: 500
    # 결제 관련 추가 설정
    # 🚀 Order 처리 관련 Kafka 설정 (수정된 부분)
    order:
      consumer:
        retry: "payment-retry-topic"                  # 결제 재시도 토픽
      retry:
        max-attempts: 3
        backoff-delay-ms: 1000
  elasticsearch:
    uris: http://elasticsearch:9200

  batch:
    jdbc:
      initialize-schema: never # 운영에선 직접 관리

FROM docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.13.4

# nori 플러그인 설치
RUN elasticsearch-plugin install analysis-nori

# --- 필요하다면 root 권한으로 전환 ---
USER root

# 디렉토리 권한 변경
RUN chown -R elasticsearch:elasticsearch /usr/share/elasticsearch/logs \
    && chmod -R 775 /usr/share/elasticsearch/logs

# --- 다시 elasticsearch 유저로 전환 ---
USER elasticsearch

# 사용자 사전, synonyms COPY
RUN mkdir -p /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/analysis
COPY ./docker/elasticsearch/userdict_ko.txt /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/analysis/userdict_ko.txt
COPY ./docker/elasticsearch/synonyms.txt /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/analysis/synonyms.txt

# 단일노드 모드, 보안 비활성
ENV discovery.type=single-node
ENV xpack.security.enabled=false
ENV ES_JAVA_OPTS "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -Dclient.encoding.override=UTF-8"

# 추가 JVM 설정이 필요하면 ENV ES_JAVA_OPTS="-Xms512m -Xmx512m" 등 지정

# domain `style` 네비게이션

## 1. 역할 요약
- SNS형 "스타일" 게시물 도메인: 구매한 주문 아이템(`OrderItem`)을 연결한 착용 사진/영상 게시물 작성·수정·삭제, 댓글/대댓글(2단계), 좋아요(게시물/댓글), 관심(북마크), 해시태그(자동완성 포함), 미디어 파일 로컬 저장/서빙.
- 조회수: 상세 조회(`GET /styles/queries/{styleId}`) 시 Kafka 이벤트를 발행하고, consumer가 `Style.viewCount` 증가 + `StyleViewLog` 버퍼링 일괄 저장. 10초 주기 스케줄러로 버퍼 flush.
- CQRS식 분리: `controller/command` + `service/command` (쓰기), `controller/query` + `service/query` (읽기, `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`).
- 루트 경로 prefix: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/style/` (이하 `style/`로 표기)

## 2. 패키지/파일 맵

### controller

|---|---|
| `style/controller/command/StyleCommandController.java` | 스타일 생성/수정/삭제, 레거시 뷰카운트 API, Nginx 캐시 퍼지 호출 |
| `style/controller/command/StyleCommentCommandController.java` | 댓글 생성/수정/삭제 |
| `style/controller/command/StyleLikeCommandController.java` | 스타일 좋아요 토글 |

## 3. REST 엔드포인트

| Method | Path | Controller 메서드 | Service 메서드 |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/styles/commands` (multipart: `orderItemIds`, `content`, `mediaFiles?`, `hashtags?`) | `StyleCommandController.createStyle` | `StyleCommandService.createStyle` → 응답 body = styleId(Long) |
| POST | `/styles/commands/{styleId}/view` (레거시) | `StyleCommandController.incrementViewCount` | `StyleCommandService.incrementViewCount` |
| PUT | `/styles/commands/{styleId}` (`content?`, `newMediaFiles?`, `existingUrlsFromFrontend?`, `hashtags?`) | `StyleCommandController.updateStyle` | `StyleCommandService.updateStyle` |
| DELETE | `/styles/commands/{styleId}` | `StyleCommandController.deleteStyle` | `StyleCommandService.deleteStyle` |
| POST | `/styles/comments/commands` (JSON `AddCommentRequestDto`) | `StyleCommentCommandController.addComment` | `StyleCommentCommandService.addComment` |
| PUT | `/styles/comments/commands/{commentId}` (JSON `updatedContent`) | `StyleCommentCommandController.updateComment` | `StyleCommentCommandService.updateComment` |
| DELETE | `/styles/comments/commands/{commentId}` | `StyleCommentCommandController.deleteComment` | `StyleCommentCommandService.deleteComment` |
| POST | `/styles/likes/commands/{styleId}/toggle` | `StyleLikeCommandController.toggleLike` | `StyleLikeCommandService.toggleLike` |
| POST | `/styles/interests/commands/{styleId}/toggle` | `StyleInterestCommandController.toggleInterest` | `StyleInterestCommandService.toggleStyleInterest` |
| POST | `/styles/comments/likes/commands/{commentId}/toggle` | `StyleCommentLikeCommandController.toggleCommentLike` | `StyleCommentLikeCommandService.toggleCommentLike` |
| POST | `/hashtags/commands` | `HashtagCommandController.createHashtag` | `HashtagCommandService.create` |
| PUT | `/hashtags/commands/{id}` | `HashtagCommandController.updateHashtag` | `HashtagCommandService.update` |
| DELETE | `/hashtags/commands/{id}` | `HashtagCommandController.deleteHashtag` | `HashtagCommandService.delete` |
| GET | `/styles/queries/{styleId}` | `StyleQueryController.getStyleDetail` | `StyleQueryService.getStyleDetail` + `StyleViewEventProducer.sendViewEvent` |
| GET | `/styles/queries` (`@ModelAttribute StyleFilterRequestDto`, Pageable) | `StyleQueryController.getFilteredStyles` | `StyleQueryService.getFilteredStyles` |
| GET | `/styles/queries/profile/{profileId}` | `StyleQueryController.getStylesByProfile` | `StyleQueryService.getStylesByProfile` |
| GET | `/styles/queries/{styleId}/media/{fileName}` | `StyleQueryController.getStyleMedia` | (서비스 없음, 컨트롤러에서 `/home/ubuntu/fream/styles/{styleId}/{fileName}` 직접 읽음) |
| GET | `/styles/queries/{styleId}/hashtags` | `StyleHashtagQueryController.getStyleHashtags` | `StyleHashtagQueryService.getHashtagsByStyleId` |

| GET | `/hashtags/queries/{id}` | `HashtagQueryController.getHashtagById` | `HashtagQueryService.findById` |
| GET | `/hashtags/queries/name/{name}` | `HashtagQueryController.getHashtagByName` | `HashtagQueryService.findByName` |
| GET | `/hashtags/queries` | `HashtagQueryController.getAllHashtags` | `HashtagQueryService.findAll` |
| GET | `/hashtags/queries/popular` | `HashtagQueryController.getPopularHashtags` | `HashtagQueryService.findPopular` |
| GET | `/hashtags/queries/search?keyword=` | `HashtagQueryController.searchHashtags` | `HashtagQueryService.search` |
| GET | `/hashtags/queries/autocomplete?keyword=&limit=10&isKorean=` | `HashtagQueryController.autocompleteHashtags` | `isKorean` 있으면 `autocomplete`, 없으면 `smartAutocomplete` |

- 인증: 쓰기 컨트롤러들은 `SecurityUtils.extractEmailFromSecurityContext()`로 email 추출 후 null/빈값/`"anonymousUser"`이면 `STYLE_ACCESS_DENIED`. 단, `updateStyle`/`deleteStyle`/`incrementViewCount` 및 해시태그 command 3종은 email 검사 없음(관리자 체크 `SecurityUtils.checkAdminRole()`은 주석 처리).

## 4. 핵심 엔티티와 관계

| 엔티티 | 주요 필드/관계 | 비고 |
|---|---|---|
| `Style` (BaseTimeEntity) | `@ManyToOne(LAZY) profile`(nullable=false), `content`, `viewCount`(Long, 기본값 없음) ; `@OneToMany(mappedBy="style", cascade=ALL, orphanRemoval=true)`: `styleOrderItems`, `mediaUrls`, `likes`, `comments`, `interests`, `hashtags`(StyleHashtag) | `StyleViewLog`은 Style 쪽 컬렉션 없음 |
| `StyleComment` (BaseTimeEntity) | `style`, `profile`, `content`, `parentComment`(self, nullable), `childComments`(cascade ALL), `likes`(StyleCommentLike, cascade ALL) | `updateContent`가 blank면 `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `StyleLike` / `StyleInterest` (BaseTimeEntity) | `style`, `profile` | DB unique 제약 없음 |
| `StyleCommentLike` (BaseTimeEntity) | `comment`, `profile` | |
| `Hashtag` (BaseTimeEntity) | `name`(unique, `#` 제외), `count`(기본 0) | 인덱스 `idx_hashtag_name`(unique), `idx_hashtag_count`; `decrementCount`는 0 미만 방지 |
| `StyleHashtag` (BaseTimeEntity) | `style`, `hashtag` | unique 인덱스 `(style_id, hashtag_id)` |
| `MediaUrl` | `url`, `style`(nullable=false) | BaseTimeEntity 미상속 |
| `StyleOrderItem` | `style`, `orderItem`(→ `domain.order.entity.OrderItem`) | BaseTimeEntity 미상속 |
| `StyleViewLog` | `viewedAt`, `userEmail`, `userAge`, `userGender`(`domain.user.entity.Gender`, STRING), `style` | |

- 역방향: `domain/user/entity/Profile.java`에 `@OneToMany(mappedBy="profile", cascade=ALL, orphanRemoval=true) List<Style> styles` 및 `addStyle/addDataStyle/removeStyle`. `Style.assignProfile`이 양방향 동기화.
- Product 연결은 직접 FK 없음: `StyleOrderItem → OrderItem → productSize → productColor → product (→ brand/collection/category)` 조인 경로를 QueryDSL에서 사용.

## 5. 주요 서비스 메서드와 비즈니스 규칙

### StyleCommandService
- `createStyle(email, orderItemIds, content, mediaFiles, hashtagNames)`: email/content 필수 → `ProfileQueryService.getProfileByEmail` → `Style(viewCount=0L)` 저장 → 주문아이템별 `StyleOrderItemCommandService.createStyleOrderItem`, 미디어별 `MediaUrlCommandService.saveMediaFile`, 해시태그 `processHashtags`. **개별 주문아이템/미디어/해시태그 실패는 로그만 남기고 계속 진행** (부분 성공).
- `processHashtags`: 앞의 `#` 1개 제거, 빈 문자열 skip, `findByName`으로 재사용 또는 `HashtagCommandService.create` 후 재조회, `StyleHashtagCommandService.addHashtagToStyle` (중복 연결이면 기존 반환, 신규면 `count++`). 대소문자 변환 없음.
- `updateStyle`: content가 null 아니고 다르면 변경; `existingUrls != null`이면 목록에 없는 MediaUrl 삭제(파일 포함); 새 파일 추가; `hashtagNames != null`이면 전체 해시태그 제거(`removeAllHashtagsFromStyle`, count 감소) 후 재등록. null 리스트는 "변경 없음".
- `deleteStyle`: 해시태그 연결 제거(실패 무시) → 미디어 파일/엔티티 삭제(개별 실패 무시) → `styleRepository.delete` (나머지는 cascade).
- `incrementViewCount`: 레거시 API용, `STYLE_NOT_FOUND` 가능.

### MediaUrlCommandService
- 검증(`validateMediaFile`): 비어있지 않음, ≤ 10MB, content-type ∈ 이미지(jpeg/jpg/png/gif/bmp/webp) 또는 비디오(mp4/mpeg/quicktime/x-msvideo/webm), 원본 파일명 존재. 위반 시 `MEDIA_FILE_INVALID`.
- 저장: `fileUtils.saveFile("styles/{styleId}", "media_", file)` (BASE_DIR `/home/ubuntu/fream`, `global/utils/FileUtils.java`) → URL `/styles/queries/{styleId}/media/{savedFileName}` 저장. 실패 시 `MEDIA_FILE_UPLOAD_FAILED`.
- 삭제: URL 마지막 `/` 뒤를 파일명으로 `fileUtils.deleteFile` (없으면 warn) → `style.removeMediaUrl` + repository delete.

### 댓글/좋아요/관심
- `StyleCommentCommandService.addComment`: 대댓글은 1단계만 허용(부모가 이미 대댓글이면 `COMMENT_CONTENT_INVALID`), 부모 댓글은 같은 스타일이어야 함, 부모 없으면 `COMMENT_NOT_FOUND`.
- `updateComment`/`deleteComment`: **작성자 소유권 검사 없음** (컨트롤러 주석은 "서비스에서 수행"이라 하지만 실제 코드에 없음). 삭제 시 자식 댓글은 cascade 삭제.
- 토글 3종(`toggleLike`, `toggleStyleInterest`, `toggleCommentLike`): `findByXAndProfile` 존재 시 delete, 없으면 생성. 예상외 오류는 `LIKE_OPERATION_FAILED`/`INTEREST_OPERATION_FAILED`.

### 조회
- `StyleRepositoryCustomImpl.filterStyles`: 1단계로 brand.name / product.collection.name / product.category.id / profile.profileName 조건으로 distinct style ID 전체 조회 → 2단계에서 `StyleResponseDto` 생성자 프로젝션(첫 MediaUrl = min(id), `likes.size()`), `sortBy="popular"`이면 `viewCount desc, id desc`, 그 외 `id desc`. total = 1단계 ID 개수. `StyleFilterRequestDto.isMainCategory`는 사용되지 않음.
- `getStyleDetail`: mediaUrls(id asc), productInfos(`groupBy(product.id, productColor.id)`, `min(salePrice)`), likeCount/commentCount. `interestCount`, `modifiedDate`는 설정되지 않음. 없으면 null → 서비스에서 `STYLE_NOT_FOUND`.
- `styleCountByColorIds(colorIds)`: colorId별 distinct style 수 — product 도메인에서 사용.
- `StyleQueryService.getFilteredStyles/getStylesByProfile/getStyleDetail`: 해시태그 Map 일괄 주입, 로그인 사용자면 liked/interested 주입(실패해도 무시). 프로필 목록은 liked만.
- `StyleCommentQueryService.getCommentsByStyleId`: 루트 댓글 페이징(최신순) + 루트마다 `findRepliesByParentCommentId` 개별 쿼리(N+1), likeCount는 `getLikes().size()`(lazy 로딩), 응답에 현재 사용자 `userProfileImageUrl` 포함. page<0 → 0, size∉(0,100] → 10.
- `HashtagQueryService` 자동완성: 키워드가 전부 초성(ㄱ~ㅎ)이면 `chosungAutocomplete`(**`findAll()` 전체 로딩 후 메모리 필터**), isKorean이면 `findByNameContainingKeywordOrderByCountDesc`(대소문자 무시 LIKE), 아니면 `findByNameStartingWithOrderByCountDesc`(prefix, 대소문자 구분).
- `HashtagCommandService`: `create`는 trim 후 중복이면 `HASHTAG_ALREADY_EXISTS`; `update`는 같은 id로 새 인스턴스 빌드 후 save(merge); `delete`는 연결된 StyleHashtag가 있으면 `HASHTAG_IN_USE`.

## 6. Kafka 조회 이벤트 파이프라인 & 스케줄러

| 단계 | 위치 | 내용 |
|---|---|---|
| 발행 | `StyleQueryController.getStyleDetail` → `StyleViewEventProducer.sendViewEvent` | 상세 조회 응답 직전 발행. 실패 시 로그만 |
| 토픽 | `style-view-log-topic` (상수, producer/consumer 각각 하드코딩) | key 없음, value JSON(`JsonSerializer`) |
| 설정 | `StyleViewEventKafkaConfig` | `${spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers}` 사용, 빈: `styleViewEventKafkaTemplate`, `styleViewEventKafkaListenerContainerFactory` |
| 소비 | `StyleViewEventConsumer.listen` (groupId `style-view-group`, `@Transactional`) | Style 조회 → `incrementViewCount()` + save → `StyleViewLog.create` 후 `viewedAt`을 이벤트 시각으로 덮어씀 → 메모리 `ConcurrentLinkedQueue` 버퍼에 추가 → 30건 이상이면 `flushBuffer()` |
| 저장 | `flushBuffer()` → `StyleViewLogRepository.saveAll` | |
| 스케줄러 | `StyleViewLogBufferManager.flushBufferPeriodically` `@Scheduled(fixedDelay = 10000)` (cron 아님, 10초) | 버퍼 flush |
| 종료 | `global/config/ApplicationShutdownConfig.java` (`ContextClosedEvent`) → `flushBufferOnShutdown()` | |

- consumer 예외는 모두 catch 후 로그만(재시도/DLT 없음).
- `@EnableScheduling`은 style 도메인 안에 없음 (다른 곳 `domain/event/scheduler/EventStatusScheduler.java`, `domain/accessLog/config/AccessLogAopConfiguration.java`에 선언).

## 11. Gotchas (코드에서 확인됨)
- 리포지토리 구조: `StyleRepository` 인터페이스가 실제로 존재하며 `JpaRepository<Style, Long>, StyleRepositoryCustom`을 함께 상속. 구현은 `StyleRepositoryCustomImpl`(Spring Data `Impl` 접미사 규칙, `JPAQueryFactory` 주입). `StyleRepositoryCustomImpl`에 구버전 `filterStyles`가 대량 주석으로 남아 있음.
- `Style.viewCount`는 `@Builder.Default` 없음 → `createStyle` 외 경로(예: `DataInitializer`, 테스트 빌더)로 생성되면 null일 수 있고 `incrementViewCount()`가 NPE. Consumer에서는 예외가 삼켜져 조회수가 조용히 증가하지 않음.
- Consumer 버퍼는 인스턴스 메모리 큐 → 프로세스 비정상 종료 시 최대 30건/10초분 로그 유실 가능. `listen`의 `@Transactional`과 `flushBuffer` 내부 호출은 같은 트랜잭션 내 실행(자기 호출).
- `GET /styles/queries/{styleId}/media/{fileName}`: `fileName`을 그대로 경로에 연결(경로 정규화/검증 없음). baseDir가 컨트롤러에 하드코딩.
- `StyleCommentCommandController.addComment`는 `StyleComment` **엔티티를 그대로 응답 body로 반환** (LAZY 연관/순환 직렬화 주의).
- `StyleCommandController.createStyle`은 `orderItemIds.size()`를 null 검사 전에 로그에서 호출. `@RequestParam("orderItemIds")`는 required이므로 실무상 null은 바인딩 단계에서 걸림.
- `HashtagCommandService.create`는 blank 이름일 때 `HASHTAG_ALREADY_EXISTS` 코드를 던짐(테스트가 이 동작을 고정). 주석의 "소문자 변환"은 실제로 하지 않음.
- `HashtagQueryService.extractChosung`은 `(c - '가') / 588 + 'ㄱ'`로 계산 — 호환 자모(U+3131~)는 초성 순서와 연속이 아니므로(ㄱ,ㄲ,ㄳ,ㄴ...) ㄱ/ㄲ 이외 초성은 잘못 매핑됨(예: '나' → 'ㄳ'). 초성 검색 결과가 부정확할 수 있음.
- `MediaUrlCommandService.saveMediaFile`은 `style.addMediaUrl`을 호출하지 않음 → 같은 트랜잭션에서 `style.getMediaUrls()`에 신규 미디어 미반영.
- `StyleOrderItem`은 같은 `OrderItem`을 여러 스타일에 연결 가능(검증 없음, 주석으로 명시). 주문 소유자 검증도 없음.
- `StyleLike`/`StyleInterest`/`StyleCommentLike`에 DB unique 제약이 없어 동시 토글 시 중복 가능.
- 레거시 `POST /styles/commands/{styleId}/view`와 Kafka 경로가 둘 다 viewCount를 증가시킴.
- `StyleFilterRequestDto.isMainCategory`, `StyleDetailResponseDto.interestCount/modifiedDate`, `StyleResponseDto.createdDate/modifiedDate`는 쿼리에서 채워지지 않음.
- `filterStyles`는 필터 결과 ID 전체를 메모리로 가져와 `IN` 절로 재조회 → 데이터가 많으면 비용 큼.

I wrote `/tmp/gne-runs/00-LLMGEN-r1-1791600468/work/nav/domain-style.md` (227 lines, Korean). Every statement in it comes from reading the code. I changed no code or tests.

**Summary for the top-level index:**
- **Role:** SNS-style posts ("Style"). A post links the author's order items and has media files, comments with one level of replies, likes, comment likes, bookmarks ("interests") and hashtags with autocomplete. Reads and writes are split into `controller|service/{command,query}`. Base paths are `/styles/{commands,queries}`, `/styles/{comments,likes,interests}/...` and `/hashtags/{commands,queries}`.
- **Top entry-point files:**
  - `domain/style/controller/command/StyleCommandController.java`
  - `domain/style/controller/query/StyleQueryController.java` (post detail sends the Kafka view event; it also serves media files)
  - `domain/style/service/command/StyleCommandService.java` (create/update/delete, plus hashtag parsing in `processHashtags`)
  - `domain/style/service/command/MediaUrlCommandService.java` (images/videos up to 10MB, stored under `/home/ubuntu/fream/styles/{id}`)
  - `domain/style/repository/StyleRepositoryCustomImpl.java` (QueryDSL feed filter, detail, profile list, `styleCountByColorIds`)
- **View pipeline:** `StyleViewEventProducer` → topic `style-view-log-topic` → `StyleViewEventConsumer` (group `style-view-group`). The consumer adds 1 to `viewCount` and buffers `StyleViewLog` rows in memory, saving them in batches of 30. `StyleViewLogBufferManager` also saves them every 10 seconds (`fixedDelay`, not cron) and at shutdown via `global/config/ApplicationShutdownConfig`.
- **Cross-domain links:**
  - user: `Profile`, `ProfileQueryService.getProfileByEmail`, `Gender`; `Profile.styles` is mapped back to `Style`.
  - order: `OrderItem` / `OrderItemQueryService`, through `StyleOrderItem`.
  - product: entities are joined in QueryDSL. In the other direction, `ProductQueryService` and `ProductColorSearchService` call `StyleRepository.styleCountByColorIds`, and `ProductQueryDslRepository` uses `QStyle`.
  - global: `FileUtils`, `NginxCachePurgeUtil` (cache purge after create/update/delete), `SecurityUtils`, `GlobalExceptionHandler`, `DataInitializer`.
  - The style package has no notification references, no Redis and no `@Cacheable`.
- **Notable findings:**
  - `StyleRepository` does exist; it extends both `JpaRepository` and `StyleRepositoryCustom`.
  - There is no owner check on style update/delete or comment update/delete. `COMMENT_ACCESS_DENIED` is defined but never used.
  - The hashtag create/update/delete endpoints check neither login nor admin role.
  - `Style.viewCount` has no default value, so it can be null and the increment can throw a null-pointer error. The consumer swallows all exceptions, so the count would silently not go up.
  - The media endpoint puts `fileName` straight into the file path without checking it, which may allow path traversal.
  - The comment create endpoint returns the `StyleComment` entity itself as the response.
  - The Korean initial-consonant (chosung) hashtag autocomplete maps characters wrongly (e.g. '나' becomes 'ㄳ'). It also loads every hashtag into memory to search.
  - Creating a style partly succeeds: a failed order item, media file or hashtag is logged and skipped.
  - Blank hashtag names are rejected with the `HASHTAG_ALREADY_EXISTS` code, and a test locks this in.
  - Tests: 2 `@DataJpaTest` repository tests and 4 Mockito service tests. There are no tests for Kafka, the scheduler or the controllers.

# 도메인: sale (판매 / 판매 입찰)

> 기준 패키지: `com.fream.back.domain.sale` — 경로 `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/`
> 엔드투엔드 판매 흐름은 `nav/flow-trade-sell.md`, 배송은 `nav/domain-shipment.md`, 창고는 `nav/domain-warehouse-storage.md` 참고.

## 1. 역할 요약
- 판매자가 **판매 입찰(SaleBid)** 을 등록하거나, 기존 **구매 입찰(OrderBid)에 즉시 판매**하는 기능.
- 판매 1건 = `Sale`(판매 상태/반송 주소/창고보관 여부) + `SaleBid`(가격/입찰 상태) + `SaleBankAccount`(정산 계좌 스냅샷, 생성 시 `user` 도메인의 BankAccount에서 복사).
- 판매자 발송(SellerShipment) 등록 진입점(`POST /sales/{saleId}/shipment`)도 이 도메인에 있으나 실제 생성은 `shipment` 도메인의 `SellerShipmentCommandService`가 수행.
- 판매 상태 `SOLD` 전환은 이 도메인이 아니라 `payment`(결제 시)와 `shipment`(구매자 운송장 등록/배송완료 시)에서 수행됨.

## 2. 패키지/파일 맵
| 레이어 | 경로 (repo root 기준) | 용도 |
|---|---|---|
| controller | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/controller/command/SaleBidCommandController.java` | 판매 입찰 생성/삭제, 즉시 판매 |
| controller | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/controller/command/SaleCommandController.java` | 판매자 발송 정보 등록 |
| controller | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/controller/query/SaleBidQueryController.java` | 내 판매 입찰 목록/카운트/상세 |
| service | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/service/command/SaleBidCommandService.java` | SaleBid 생성/즉시판매/삭제 |
| service | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/service/command/SaleCommandService.java` | Sale 생성, 즉시판매 Sale 생성, 상태 전환, SellerShipment 위임 |
| service | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/service/command/SaleBankAccountCommandService.java` | SaleBankAccount 저장 |
| service | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/service/query/SaleBidQueryService.java` | SaleBid 조회 (타 도메인에서도 사용) |
| entity | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/entity/Sale.java` | 판매 엔티티 |
| entity | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/entity/SaleBid.java` | 판매 입찰 엔티티 |
| entity | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/entity/SaleBankAccount.java` | 판매 정산 계좌 |
| entity | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/entity/SaleStatus.java` | 판매 상태 enum + `canTransitionTo` |
| entity | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/entity/BidStatus.java` | 판매 입찰 상태 enum (order 도메인에 동명 enum 별도 존재) |
| repository | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/repository/SaleRepository.java` | `findBySeller_EmailAndStatus` |
| repository | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/repository/SaleBidRepository.java` | `findByOrder_Id`, `findBySale_Id` + Custom |
| repository | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/repository/SaleBidRepositoryCustom.java` / `SaleBidRepositoryImpl.java` | QueryDSL 목록/카운트/상세 |
| repository | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/repository/SaleBankAccountRepository.java` | 기본 JPA |
| dto | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/dto/SaleBidRequestDto.java` | 판매 입찰 요청 (productSizeId, bidPrice, returnAddress, postalCode, receiverPhone, warehouseStorage) |
| dto | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/dto/InstantSaleRequestDto.java` | 즉시 판매 요청 (orderBidId, 반송 정보) |
| dto | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/dto/ShipmentRequestDto.java` | 판매자 발송 (courier, trackingNumber) |
| dto | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/dto/SaleBidResponseDto.java` | 목록/상세 응답 (상태 한글 변환 헬퍼 포함) |
| dto | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/dto/SaleBidStatusCountDto.java` | 상태별 개수 |
| exception | `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/exception/SaleErrorCode.java`, `SaleException.java` | 에러코드 (현재 미사용, 아래 참조) |

## 3. REST 엔드포인트
| HTTP | 경로 | 컨트롤러 메서드 | 서비스 메서드 | 응답 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/sale-bids` | `SaleBidCommandController.createSaleBid` | `SaleBidCommandService.createSaleBid` | `Long` saleBidId |
| DELETE | `/sale-bids/{saleBidId}` | `SaleBidCommandController.deleteSaleBid` | `SaleBidCommandService.deleteSaleBid` | 200 |
| POST | `/sale-bids/instant` | `SaleBidCommandController.createInstantSale` | `SaleBidCommandService.createInstantSaleBid` → `SaleCommandService.createInstantSale` | `Long` **saleId** (saleBidId 아님) |
| POST | `/sales/{saleId}/shipment` | `SaleCommandController.createSellerShipment` | `SaleCommandService.createSellerShipment` → `SellerShipmentCommandService.createSellerShipment` | 200 |
| GET | `/sale-bids?saleBidStatus=&saleStatus=&page..` | `SaleBidQueryController.getSaleBids` | `SaleBidQueryService.getSaleBids` → `SaleBidRepositoryImpl.findSaleBidsByFilters` | `ResponseDto<Page<SaleBidResponseDto>>` |
| GET | `/sale-bids/count` | `SaleBidQueryController.getSaleBidStatusCounts` | `SaleBidQueryService.getSaleBidStatusCounts` | `ResponseDto<SaleBidStatusCountDto>` |
| GET | `/sale-bids/{saleBidId}` | `SaleBidQueryController.getSaleBidDetail` | `SaleBidQueryService.getSaleBidDetail` | `ResponseDto<SaleBidResponseDto>` |

- 사용자 식별: `SecurityUtils.extractEmailFromSecurityContext()` (delete, `/sales/{id}/shipment`는 이메일/소유자 검증 없음).
- `SecurityConfig`는 화이트리스트 외 `anyRequest().authenticated()`; 이 도메인 경로는 화이트리스트 grep 결과 없음.

## 4. 핵심 엔티티와 관계
| 엔티티 | 주요 필드 | 연관관계 |
|---|---|---|
| `Sale` (extends BaseTimeEntity) | returnAddress, postalCode, receiverPhone, `isWarehouseStorage`, `status: SaleStatus` | `seller` ManyToOne User; `productSize` ManyToOne ProductSize; `payment` OneToOne(mappedBy=sale, cascade ALL) `payment.Payment`; `saleBankAccount` OneToOne(mappedBy); `saleBid` OneToOne(mappedBy); `sellerShipment` OneToOne(mappedBy) `shipment.SellerShipment` |
| `SaleBid` | `bidPrice`(int), `status: BidStatus`(기본 PENDING), `isInstantSale`(기본 false) | `seller` ManyToOne User; `productSize` ManyToOne; `sale` OneToOne(FK sale_id); `order` OneToOne(FK order_id) `order.Order` |
| `SaleBankAccount` | bankName, accountNumber, accountHolder | `sale` OneToOne(FK sale_id, not null) |

외부에서 Sale을 참조: `order.entity.OrderBid.sale`(FK sale_id), `payment.entity.Payment.sale`, `shipment.entity.SellerShipment.sale`, `warehouseStorage.entity.WarehouseStorage.sale`.

### SaleStatus (`SaleStatus.canTransitionTo`)
| 현재 | 허용 다음 상태 |
|---|---|
| PENDING_SHIPMENT | IN_TRANSIT |
| IN_TRANSIT | IN_INSPECTION |
| IN_INSPECTION | FAILED_INSPECTION, IN_STORAGE |
| IN_STORAGE | ON_AUCTION, AUCTION_EXPIRED, SELLING |
| ON_AUCTION | SOLD, AUCTION_EXPIRED |
| SELLING | SOLD, AUCTION_EXPIRED, ON_AUCTION |
| SOLD / AUCTION_EXPIRED / FAILED_INSPECTION | 없음 |

`Sale.updateStatus()`는 규칙을 검사하지 않음. 규칙 검사는 `SaleCommandService.updateSaleStatus`와 `OrderShipmentCommandService.updateSaleStatusToSold`만 수행.

### sale `BidStatus`
`PENDING, MATCHED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED`. `SaleBid.assignSale()`/`assignOrder()`는 **호출 즉시 status=MATCHED** 로 바꿈.

## 5. 주요 서비스 메서드와 비즈니스 규칙
| 메서드 | 동작 | 예외 |
|---|---|---|
| `SaleBidCommandService.createSaleBid(email, productSizeId, bidPrice, returnAddress, postalCode, receiverPhone, isWarehouseStorage)` @Transactional | User 조회 → ProductSize 조회 → `SaleCommandService.createSale` → SaleBid(PENDING) save → `sale.assignSaleBid(saleBid)` (→ SaleBid가 **MATCHED** 로 바뀜) | ProductSize 없음: `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `SaleCommandService.createSale(...)` | `BankAccountQueryService.getBankAccount(email)` → Sale(PENDING_SHIPMENT, isWarehouseStorage) save → SaleBankAccount 생성/연결 → 판매자에게 알림 "판매 입찰이 등록되었습니다." | 계좌 없으면 user 도메인의 `BankAccountNotFoundException` |
| `SaleBidCommandService.createInstantSaleBid(orderBidId, email, ...)` | `SaleCommandService.createInstantSale` 먼저 호출 → OrderBid 재조회 → SaleBid(MATCHED, bidPrice=orderBid.bidPrice, order=orderBid.order) 생성/저장 → saleId 반환 | OrderBid 없음: `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `SaleCommandService.createInstantSale(...)` | OrderBid 조회 → Sale(PENDING_SHIPMENT, productSize=orderBid.productSize, isWarehouseStorage 미설정=false) save → SaleBankAccount → `orderBid.assignSale(sale)` + `orderBid.updateStatus(order.BidStatus.MATCHED)` → 구매자에게 알림 "구매 입찰에 판매자가 등록되었습니다." | OrderBid 없음: `IllegalArgumentException`. OrderBid 상태/중복 매칭 검증 없음 |
| `SaleBidCommandService.deleteSaleBid(id)` | order 연결 시 거부, sale 있으면 `SaleCommandService.deleteSale` 후 SaleBid 삭제 | `IllegalArgumentException`(없음), `IllegalStateException`(Order 연결) |
| `SaleCommandService.createSellerShipment(saleId, courier, tracking)` | `SellerShipmentCommandService.createSellerShipment` → `updateSaleStatus(saleId, IN_TRANSIT)` | 전환 불가 시 `IllegalStateException` |
| `SaleCommandService.updateSaleStatus(saleId, status)` | `canTransitionTo` 검사 후 변경 (System.out 디버그 출력 있음) | `IllegalArgumentException`, `IllegalStateException` |
| `SaleBidQueryService.findByOrderId(orderId)` | 없으면 **예외** (`IllegalArgumentException`) | — |
| `SaleBidQueryService.findBySaleId(saleId)` | 없으면 `null` | — |
| `SaleBidRepositoryImpl.findSaleBidsByFilters` | seller.email 조인 조건, 상태는 `stringValue().eq(문자열)`, Product/Color/thumbnailImage inner join, Sale/SellerShipment left join, createdDate desc | — |
| `SaleBidRepositoryImpl.countSaleBidsByStatus` | pending / matched / (cancelled+completed) 3개 카운트 | — |
| `SaleBidRepositoryImpl.findSaleBidById(id, email)` | 소유자 아니면 null → 컨트롤러가 `IllegalArgumentException` | — |

## 6. 다른 도메인과의 의존
| 방향 | 대상 | 내용 |
|---|---|---|
| sale → user | `UserQueryService.findByEmail`, `BankAccountQueryService.getBankAccount` | 판매자, 정산 계좌 |
| sale → product | `ProductSizeQueryService.findById` | |
| sale → order | `OrderBidQueryService.findById`, `OrderBid.assignSale/updateStatus` | 즉시 판매 |
| sale → notification | `NotificationCommandService.createNotification(…, SHOPPING, BID, msg)` | |
| sale → shipment | `SellerShipmentCommandService.createSellerShipment` | |
| order → sale | `OrderBidCommandService.createInstantOrderBid`(즉시 구매: `SaleBidQueryService.findById`), `OrderCommandService.createInstantOrder`(`saleBid.assignOrder`, MATCHED, 창고상태 ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER) | |
| payment → sale | `PaymentCommandService.notifyUsersAndUpdateSaleStatus` → `sale.updateStatus(SOLD)` (전환 규칙 미검사) | |
| shipment → sale | `OrderShipmentCommandService.updateSaleStatusToSold`, `updateOrderAndSaleBidStatusToCompleted`(SaleBid MATCHED→COMPLETED); `SellerShipmentCommandService`(Sale→IN_STORAGE) | |
| warehouseStorage → sale | `WarehouseStorage.sale`, `findBySale` | |
| global | `DataInitializer`(시드: Sale PENDING_SHIPMENT 등), `GlobalExceptionHandler`(`SaleException` 핸들러) | |

Kafka / Redis / 스케줄러: 이 도메인 내 사용 없음 (grep 확인).

## 7. 예외/에러코드
- `SaleErrorCode` (S001~S501), `SaleException extends GlobalException` — **어디서도 throw 되지 않음**(grep 결과 0건). 실제로는 `IllegalArgumentException`/`IllegalStateException`을 던지며 `GlobalExceptionHandler.handleException`(Exception.class)에서 **500** 으로 응답됨.
- 코드 접두사 `S001`, `S002` 등이 `ShipmentErrorCode`와 **중복**.

## 8. 관련 테스트
| 파일 | 종류 | 내용 |
|---|---|---|
| `src/test/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/entity/SaleEntityTest.java` | 단위 | SaleStatus 전환 매트릭스, SaleBid 기본값, assignSale/assignOrder→MATCHED, `updateStatus`가 규칙 미검사 |
| `src/test/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/service/SaleBidCommandServiceTest.java` | Mockito | createSaleBid가 MATCHED로 끝남, 즉시판매 가격/순서, 삭제 규칙 |
| `src/test/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/service/SaleCommandServiceTest.java` | Mockito | createSale/createInstantSale/updateSaleStatus/createSellerShipment/deleteSale |
| `src/test/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/repository/SaleBidRepositoryTest.java` | `@DataJpaTest` | QueryDSL 필터/프로젝션/페이징/카운트/소유자 검사 |
| `src/test/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/dto/SaleBidDtoTest.java` | 단위 | DTO |

## 9. 자주 할 작업 → 여기를 보라
| 작업 | 위치 |
|---|---|
| 판매 상태 전환 규칙 변경 | `SaleStatus.canTransitionTo` + `SaleEntityTest.saleStatusTransitionMatrix` |
| 판매 입찰 생성 로직/검증 추가 | `SaleBidCommandService.createSaleBid`, `SaleCommandService.createSale` |
| 즉시 판매 검증(OrderBid 상태 등) 추가 | `SaleCommandService.createInstantSale` |
| 내 판매 목록 필드/필터 추가 | `SaleBidRepositoryImpl` + `SaleBidResponseDto` 생성자 순서(Projections.constructor) |

## 10. Gotchas (코드로 확인)
1. **일반 판매 입찰이 생성 직후 MATCHED**: `createSaleBid`에서 `sale.assignSaleBid()` → `SaleBid.assignSale()`가 status=MATCHED로 설정 (테스트 `createSaleBidCreatesSaleAndBidAndEndsMatched`가 이 동작을 고정). 따라서 `/sale-bids/count`의 pending은 일반 경로로는 증가하지 않음.
2. **DTO 검증 미적용**: 이 도메인 컨트롤러는 `@Valid` 없이 `@RequestBody` 사용 → `SaleBidRequestDto`/`InstantSaleRequestDto`/`ShipmentRequestDto`의 `@NotBlank/@Pattern/@Min` 무시됨.

5. 즉시 판매 응답은 saleId, 판매 입찰 응답은 saleBidId.
6. `deleteSaleBid`는 소유자 확인 없음. 이미 MATCHED라도 order가 null이면 삭제됨.
7. sale `BidStatus`와 `order.entity.BidStatus`가 동명 enum — `SaleCommandService`는 order 쪽을 import, `SaleBidCommandService`는 sale 쪽을 import.
8. 창고보관 판매에 `POST /sales/{saleId}/shipment` 호출 시: `SellerShipmentCommandService`가 Sale을 `IN_STORAGE`로 바꾼 뒤 `updateSaleStatus(IN_TRANSIT)`가 `IN_STORAGE→IN_TRANSIT` 불가로 `IllegalStateException` → 트랜잭션 롤백(500). 결제로 이미 SOLD가 된 Sale도 동일하게 실패. (`/shipments/seller`는 IN_TRANSIT 전환을 하지 않아 통과)
9. `IN_INSPECTION`, `FAILED_INSPECTION`, `ON_AUCTION`, `SELLING`, `AUCTION_EXPIRED`로 설정하는 코드 없음 (enum/표시용 문자열만 존재).

# domain: product

## 역할 요약
- 상품 카탈로그 도메인: `Product`(상품) → `ProductColor`(색상별 SKU 묶음, 이미지/상세HTML/관심) → `ProductSize`(사이즈별 구매가/판매가/재고) 계층과 `Brand`/`Category`(2단계 계층)/`Collection` 마스터 데이터를 관리한다.
- 상품 목록 검색은 두 경로가 공존한다: **QueryDSL(DB)** `/products/query`, `/products/indexed/search`와 **Elasticsearch** `/es/products`. 상세 내용은 `nav/flow-product-search.md`.
- 상품 상세 조회 시 Kafka(`view-log-topic`)로 조회 이벤트를 발행해 `ProductColorViewLog` 테이블에 적재한다.
- `ProductSize`는 order/sale 도메인의 거래 대상(FK `product_size_id`)이다.

## 패키지/파일 맵

ProductSize 전용 REST 엔드포인트는 없다(색상 생성/수정 시 `sizes` 리스트로 처리).

(`BaseTimeEntity` 상속: ProductColorViewLog 제외 전부)

| 엔티티 (테이블) | 주요 필드 | 연관관계 |

| `ProductColor` (`product_color`) | colorName, content(`@Lob` HTML) | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` product; `@OneToOne(cascade=ALL, orphanRemoval)` thumbnailImage (`thumbnail_image_id`); `@OneToMany(cascade=ALL, orphanRemoval)` sizes, productImages, productDetailImages, interests |
| `ProductSize` (`product_size`) | sizeType(`SizeType`), size(String), purchasePrice, salePrice, quantity | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` productColor. `update(purchase, sale, qty)` |
| `ProductImage` | imageUrl(파일명만) | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` productColor (nullable=false). 썸네일도 이 엔티티 |
| `ProductDetailImage` | imageUrl | `@ManyToOne(LAZY)` productColor |
| `Brand` / `Collection` | name | 단독 |
| `Category` (`category`) | name | self `@ManyToOne` parentCategory(`parent_category_id`), `@OneToMany` subCategories(cascade ALL). 메인=parent null, 서브=parent 있음 |
| `Interest` | — | `@ManyToOne` user(`user_id`, user 도메인 `User`), productColor. `User.interests`와 양방향 |
| `ProductPriceHistory` | price, priceType(String) | `@ManyToOne` productSize. **코드에서 생성/사용처 없음** (repository만 존재) |
| `ProductColorViewLog` | viewedAt, userEmail, userAge, userGender(user 도메인 `Gender`) | `@ManyToOne` productColor. Kafka consumer가 저장 |

Enum 값:
- `GenderType`: MALE, FEMALE, KIDS, UNISEX
- `SizeType`: CLOTHING(XXS~XXXL, 28~36), SHOES(70~330), ACCESSORIES(ONE_SIZE) — `getSizes()`가 허용 사이즈 목록
- `ColorType`(displayName): BLACK(블랙), GREY, WHITE, IVORY, BEIGE, BROWN, KHAKI, GREEN, LIGHT_GREEN, MINT, NAVY, BLUE, SKY_BLUE, PURPLE, PINK, RED, ORANGE, YELLOW, SILVER, GOLD, MIX(믹스)

| `#updateProductColor` | colorName 변경 시에만 검증. 썸네일 교체 시 기존 파일 삭제. `existingImages`/`existingDetailImages`에 없는 기존 이미지는 파일+엔티티 삭제. `sizes`가 주어지면 diff로 제거/추가 |
| `#deleteProductColor` | interests 삭제 → sizes 삭제 → 썸네일/이미지/상세이미지 파일 및 엔티티 삭제 → color 삭제 |
| `ProductSizeCommandService#createProductSizes` | 루트 카테고리명(`CLOTHING`/`SHOES`/`ACCESSORIES`, 대소문자 무시)으로 SizeType 결정, 아니면 INVALID_SIZE_TYPE. 이미 있는 사이즈 skip. 초기값 purchasePrice=salePrice=releasePrice, quantity=0. 유효 사이즈는 먼저 저장하고 무효 사이즈가 있으면 마지막에 INVALID_SIZE_TYPE 예외(트랜잭션 롤백 여부는 호출 트랜잭션에 따름) |
| `#updateProductSize` | 가격/재고 수정 메서드. **main 코드 내 호출처 없음**(테스트만) |
| `InterestCommandService#toggleInterest` | 이메일로 User 조회, 존재하면 삭제/없으면 생성(양방향 편의 메서드 사용). 실패 → INTEREST_TOGGLE_FAILED |
| `BrandCommandService` | 이름 중복 → BRAND_ALREADY_EXISTS(409). 삭제 시 `productRepository.existsByBrand` → BRAND_IN_USE |
| `CategoryCommandService` | `subCategoryName == null`이면 메인 생성, 아니면 메인 하위에 서브 생성. 삭제 시 하위 카테고리 존재 또는 상품 연결 → CATEGORY_IN_USE |
| `CollectionCommandService` | 중복 → COLLECTION_ALREADY_EXISTS, 삭제 시 상품 연결 → COLLECTION_IN_USE. `createOrGetCollection` |
| `FilterService#getAllFilterData` | 카테고리 필터는 메인 "Clothing"의 서브 카테고리들 + 메인 "Shoes"(이름 하드코딩)를 1단계로 사용. 할인/가격대 옵션은 하드코딩 |

**인프라**

## 예외/에러코드 위치
- `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/product/exception/ProductErrorCode.java` — 접두사: P(상품), PC(색상), PS(사이즈), CT(카테고리), BD(브랜드), CL(컬렉션), IN(관심), IMG(이미지), FT(필터), KF(Kafka; 정의만 있고 사용처 없음)

## Gotchas (코드에서 확인됨)
1. **ES 인덱스 동기화 없음**: `ProductColorIndexingService#indexColorById`/`#deleteColorFromIndex`는 정의만 있고 호출처가 없다. 인덱스는 앱 시작 시 `ProductColorIndexInitializer`가 삭제→재생성→전체 색인할 때만 갱신된다. CUD 후에는 Nginx 캐시 purge만 호출된다.
2. **상세 조회 사이즈 버그**: `ProductQueryDslRepository#findProductDetail`의 사이즈 조회가 `productSize.productColor.colorName.eq(colorName)`만 조건으로 써서, 같은 colorName을 가진 **다른 상품의 사이즈까지** 섞인다(테스트로 고정됨).
3. **interestCount 부풀림**: 검색 쿼리가 sizes와 interests를 함께 left join 후 `interest.count()` → 관심 수 × 사이즈 행 수.
4. **countProductsByFilter**: 같은 쿼리를 두 번 실행하며, 실제 반환하는 두 번째 쿼리에 collection 조건이 빠져 있다.
5. **페이징 불일치**: 검색 content는 (product, color) 단위 행인데 total은 `product.id.countDistinct()`.
6. `searchProductsByColorIds`: `productColor.thumbnailImage.imageUrl` 경로 참조로 썸네일 없는 색상이 결과에서 빠진다.
7. **ProductColor 삭제 실패 가능**: `InterestCommandService#deleteAllInterestsByProductColor`가 `productColor.getInterests().forEach` 안에서 `unassignProductColor()`(같은 리스트 remove)를 호출 → 관심이 있는 색상은 ConcurrentModificationException → ProductException(INTEREST_TOGGLE_FAILED). 테스트로 확인됨. 상품 삭제도 이 경로를 탄다.
8. `CreateSizesJobConfig`의 `createSizesJob`이 `ProductColorCommandService`에 `JobLauncher`와 함께 주입되지만 `jobLauncher.run` 호출은 없다(사이즈는 동기 생성).
9. `ProductQueryController#getProductDetail`: `SecurityUtils.extractEmailOrAnonymous()`는 미인증 시 `"anonymous"`를 반환하지만 컨트롤러는 `"anonymousUser"`와 비교한다. `extractUserInfo()`가 null이면 `userInfo.getAge()`에서 NPE → 외부 `catch (Exception)`에서 PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND로 변환된다(실제 발생 여부는 인증 필터 동작에 따름, 미확인).
10. QueryDSL 검색에서 `sortOption`이 non-null인데 field가 price/releaseDate/interestCount가 아니면 정렬이 아예 없다. `ProductSearchDto.validate()`는 sortOption null이면 `interestCount desc` 기본값을 넣는다. `IndexedProductRepository#applySortingOptimized`는 `getField().toLowerCase()`라 field null이면 NPE.
11. `IndexedProductRepository`: 이름으로 ID를 찾지 못하면(빈 리스트) 해당 필터가 **무시**되어 전체가 조회된다.
12. 페이징: `application.yml`의 `spring.data.web.pageable.one-indexed-parameters: true`, default-page-size 10.
13. 브랜드/컬렉션 DELETE는 path가 ID가 아니라 **이름**이다. PUT은 ID.
14. `ProductCommandService`의 `System.out` 대신 `ProductQueryDslRepository`에 `System.out.println` 디버그 출력 다수.
15. 카테고리 기반 SizeType 결정은 루트 카테고리 이름이 정확히 Clothing/Shoes/Accessories(대소문자 무시)여야 한다.
